branch_stage_dependencies.rule: Every cross-station change invokes MOVE after source safe release and before destination handling. Generic MOVE is a reusable hook, not only one visit near route start.
All required accepted part/member/joint receipts precede assembly acceptance. Enclosed fabrication output must physically be unloaded before part inspection.
Both bifurcation routes perform GUIDE_CONFIG before MOUNT_CHECK. Guide change only at supported zero-load state and generates a new fixture signature.
Finish acquisition, stop/retract or release preload through SAFE_UNLOAD at actual current test station, then MOVE to archive. Never transport an attached/acquiring/preloaded-unsupported specimen.
ONE_BIT_MANUAL does not require force-torque acquisition. Supplied noncontact visual/angle classifier and optical safety are needed; any powered actuation linkage must be released before grip.

Before each two-bit route start, require observed 00. For the 01 route require second-bit preparation with first input free, then second-drive disengagement and observed 01 before first-bit-only operation.
Processing follows actual acquisition; modeled energy and source outcome numbers never substitute for measurements.
COMPARE_SETUP captures baseline and starts observation; COMPARE_FOLD and COMPARE_OBSERVE overlap in place; released window completes before recording closes.
ONE_BIT_MANUAL RELEASE_TORQUE requires actual grip release and evidence any powered linkage is absent/released; no invented motor or decoupler is assumed.
MOVE applies to physical object station changes, not analysis-service access to already acquired records. Analysis does not teleport a mounted sample to WS_RECORDS.

loop_expansion: Dependencies bind within trial/condition scope. RESET_STATE links prior final state to new initial observation; it never creates a global cyclic DAG. Conditional edges do not imply absent stages.
no_fixed_solution: Accept alternative safe valid assembly/control orders satisfying object state and causal evidence; operation names are not success events
